item.title: Re: Nechronometer
item.content:encoded:
So the overall story is her trying to not only deal with her powers and try to have a normal life, but also try and fulfill a task that death gave to her after meeting him in either this or the next tale. Some major plot points of it would be getting captured and sold by MC&D, and her escaping from that, training, and the toll of constantly being hunted by massive organizations.

She's not part of the foundation, and probably won't be for most of the series. She starts off as a CIA/SAC operative, than moves to being on the run.

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Junior Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Pau_Gaba, per the Site's Criticism Policy found here: http://www.scp-wiki.net/criticism-policy

Criticism should be helpful in some way.

Try to give the author an idea of where to take their concept/draft, or what might make their current article better. What about the concept looks curious? What did you find interesting about it? What would you suggest would help this concept to its full potential? Should the concept stay simple and weird, or should that change? If so, in which ways should it change? Which parts specifically should the author expand on more? Please try to offer a more detailed response in the future when dropping critique. It would better help the author if the critique was more specific and direct, so the author knows exactly what to modify and/or keep within their idea.

If you need more assistance with how to properly write a review, please consider referring to this thread for guidance: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-9804362/so-you-want-to-be-a-concept-reviewer

item.title: Re: Nechronometer
item.content:encoded:
This could be interesting, but you didn't really give us a narrative only a plot point. I'm going to need some more info on the entire story your trying to tell to judge correctly.

But based on what you have here, there going to be some explanation on why the Foundation is using an anomaly for their team and maybe on what that means for her. Or this could a canon where the Foundation will use anomalous means to deal with threats accordingly.

For a tale it sounds like it would do pretty good, but I don't have to much to go off of so I have no idea what the actual tale is going to be like, so that's really the only input I can give. item.title: Nechronometer
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Genre (Optional):Drama/Emotional, Action

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: Gal joins a CIA task force to retrieve anom artifacts and ends up over her head

Central Narrative: A newly transferred Jordan is attached to an anomaly recovery team and sent out to retrieve a fountain held in.1 After dispatching a few guards outside the perimeter, they get ambushed by void things, tearing her squad to shreds. She tries to save one of them by rewinding time around her wound. She's able to, but ends up dying to the void-things soon after.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The "new" gal (Jordan) is an anomaly herself, able to rewind time at extremely local areas. Her team doesn't know, and she doesn't know the full extent of what she can do until now

Additional Notes: This is gonna be the first of a series (taking suggestions for names) Also Voidthings is a placeholder for another name

Footnotes
1. fountain creates a protective barrier around wherever the water is poured in a circle, and conjures a void-thing to hunt down w/e crossed it
